! Title: Proprietary Script Hosts (FSF-oriented)
! Description: Curated filters for scripts and telemetry endpoints operated by proprietary software vendors. Selection is vendor-oriented, not solely behaviour-based.
! Homepage: https://github.com/fpucore/ubo-lists
! License: CC-BY-4.0
! Version: 0.1.1
! Last modified: 2026-11-05
!
! Filter behaviour:
! - Rules without redirect= block matching requests.
! - redirect=noop.js blocks the original request and substitutes uBO's noop.js resource.
! - Redirecting a script does not preserve its functionality; dependent site features may break.
! - $image rules block matching image requests, typically tracking pixels.
!
! Redirect rules use uBO's built-in redirect resource token; no separate dashboard toggle is required.
!
!########## Google: Analytics, Tag Manager, Ads ##########

||google-analytics.com^$script,third-party
||ssl.google-analytics.com^$script,third-party
||www.google-analytics.com^$script,third-party
||analytics.google.com^$script,third-party
||region1.google-analytics.com^$script,third-party
||stats.g.doubleclick.net^$script,third-party

||googletagservices.com^$script,third-party

!########## Google: reCAPTCHA (proprietary, widely used) ##########
!# redirect, not block: blocking hard breaks most sign-up and contact forms.

||recaptcha.net^$script,third-party,redirect=noop.js
||www.recaptcha.net^$script,third-party,redirect=noop.js
||www.google.com/recaptcha/$script,third-party,redirect=noop.js
